name: LSW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned by the time of the wing's own Monday Massacre broadcasts, contested between 'Deadly' Dave Morgan and Dangerous D-Vo Wilson -- the crowd's own signage at the broadcast's opening ('Morgan was screwed out of the belt!') implicates a contested decision in Wilson's favor, and Wilson is repeatedly billed the promotion's own Heavyweight Champion from that night forward. The deciding match itself does not survive in this collection's holdings, so no reign is logged. A cage-match defense against Kiwi Justice is announced for the promotion's first supercard, Disturbance In Dallas, outcome not held.
notes: An earlier tournament semifinal (Morgan defeats Trevor McWade) is held on the wing's own Monday Massacre Highlight page; the final itself is not held.

name: LSW Regional Championship
epitaph: Held by Trevor McWade as of the wing's own Monday Massacre broadcasts; a defense against number-one contender 'Deadly' Dave Morgan is announced for the promotion's first supercard, Disturbance In Dallas, outcome not held in the held record.

name: LSW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced vacant as of the wing's own Monday Massacre broadcasts, to be decided in a Four Way Bunkhouse Dance at the promotion's first supercard, Disturbance In Dallas, among The Ukrainian Brothers, The Desperados, Too Hot To Handle and Pain and Agony -- outcome not held in the held record.
